verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v1: ʾijāzatu ʾilā l-ʿulā tartafiʿu maqbūlatu falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v2: minhā khiyāru ʾummahi tantafiʿu biʾidhnihi falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v3: bihā yusarru sāliku muttabiʿu wawāfidu falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v4: tujīzu ʾiʿṭāʾa liman yanqaṭiʿu ʾilā s-samā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v5: yudrikuhu man yantamī ʾaw yarjiʿu liquṭbinā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v6: sabaqa ʾanna tarkahu yamtaniʿu ʿalā mriʾi falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v7: qad khāba man bidīnihi yuraqqiʿu dunyā l-khanā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v8: wad-dīnu la yasaʿuhu muttasiʿu mina l-faḍā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v9: ʾasmaʿahu l-ʾajyāla kula musmiʿu bayna l-warā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v10: l-mawtu fīhā jannatu taqtaniʿu binūrihā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v11: man la yurīduhā wala yartadiʿu fafī sh-shaqā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v12: ʾadlā bihi l-badru lladhī yuwaqqiʿu bikhātami falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v13: ṣallā l-ʾilahu mā ghadā tajtamiʿu ʾaṣḥābuhu falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v14: ʿalayhi wal-ʾāli l-ʾulā qad samiʿū mā qālahu falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v15: mā shtāqa mushtāqu kaman yastawdiʿu liẓillihi falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v16: qad zurtuhu hunāka wahwa mawḍiʿu muqaddasu falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v17: faqultu hadhī ʾadmuʿu tandafiʿu maṣbūbata falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v18: ʿan wad-dī lladhī ghadā l-mubtadiʿu yakhāfuhu falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v19: yuḥḥibu mā fīka wala yushajjiʿu ʾila ṣ-ṣafā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v20: wal-hudā fī ḥaḍratayhi mawqiʿu war-riḍā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v21: māzāla khulqu l-fāṭimī yanṭabiʿu fī khulqihi falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v22: bayna l-kirāmi sh-shummi la la yūqiʿu ʿadāwata falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v23: tawassulī bihi ʾilayka yuqniʿu tawassulī falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v24: ʾammā t-taʿʿaluqu bihi fayusriʿu tilka l-khuṭā falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
verses.ijazatun-ila-l-ula-tartafi-u-c1-v25: bal ʾinnahu mina ṣ-ṣudūri yanziʿu maẓannata falyaʿlami l-muṭṭaliʿu
